scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const [from,to] of [['dist-electron/main/main.js','dist-electron/main/main.cjs'],['dist-electron/preload/preload.js','dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs']]) fs.copyFileSync(from,to)"
scripts.prebuild: npm run build:preload && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: npm run prebuild && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:dir: npm run prebuild && vite build && electron-builder --dir
